focus: C1 (§3bis) compositional two-way voice redesign + Goal 1 (§3)

evidence.description: Confirmed on disk: muLawBufToPcm16, pcm16BufToMuLaw, resamplePcm16, twilioMuLawToGeminiPcm16 (8k mu-law -> 16k PCM, directly reusable for STT input per C1's own '8k->16k upsample before STT' bullet), buildTelnyxMediaFrame, parseTelnyxStart, telnyxDialBody, telnyxStreamingStartBody are all real, exported functions -- C1's claim that call-logic.js's mu-law/PCM16/resample/Telnyx-frame primitives are reusable is TRUE, not fabricated.
Confirmed Goal 1's 'live_ws_opened=0' counter mechanism already exists as a working pattern in the CURRENT (old-design) server.js -- extending it for the new design is plausible.

resamplePcm16 (linear interpolation, mono LE int16) is generic and correctly reusable for both the 8k->16k STT-input path and any TTS-output resample the new design needs -- no correctness defect in the reused primitives themselves.

Goal 1's proof condition itself ('caller asks a follow-up and gets a spoken answer, AND live_ws_opened=0 in the app log, for that call') IS concretely provable by a single real answered call + log grep -- this part of verification readiness is sound and requires no fix.
